---
title: "Architecture"
---

IrisPipe is a **Spring Boot 3 + Spring Batch 5** application backed by an embedded H2 database.
The frontend is a React 19 single-page application communicating over REST and Server-Sent Events.

---

## Stack

| Layer | Technology |
|---|---|
| Runtime | Java 21, Spring Boot 3 |
| Pipeline execution | Spring Batch 5 |
| Persistence | H2 (embedded, file-mode), JPA / Hibernate, Flyway |
| Observability | Micrometer, Prometheus endpoint |
| Frontend | React 19, React Router v7, TailwindCSS, DaisyUI |
| Real-time | Server-Sent Events (SSE) |
| Testing | JUnit 5 (backend), k6 (integration / regression) |

---

## Backend Package Map

```
irispipe/
├── api/                          REST controllers — request binding only
├── batch/                        Spring Batch builders, listeners, tasklets, writers
├── core/
│   ├── factory/                  Runtime job/step assembly from snapshot
│   └── service/                  Execution and query orchestration facades
├── infrastructure/
│   ├── config/                   Spring bean configuration, mappers
│   ├── context/                  Runtime DB context objects
│   ├── entity/                   JPA entities (config vs runtime domains)
│   ├── repo/                     JPA repositories
│   └── service/
│       ├── config/               Config command, import, read-model, policy
│       ├── folder/               Folder tree command, read-model, structure
│       ├── runtime/              Run lifecycle, snapshot, watermark, metadata
│       └── workspace/            Workspace resolution
├── model/                        Domain records, enums, mutable summaries
│   └── dto/                      API DTOs
└── observability/                Metric publishing, lifecycle events
```

**Controller → Facade → Collaborator** is the enforced call direction.
Controllers do not call collaborators directly.
Facades do not implement storage — they delegate to collaborators.

---

## Database Schema

Two logical groups of tables:

### Config tables

```sql
iris_workspace                    -- workspace registry
iris_pipeline_folder              -- folder tree nodes
iris_pipeline                     -- pipeline definition
iris_pipeline_job                 -- job definition (source, dest, stage)
iris_pipeline_job_connection      -- named connection library entries
iris_pipeline_execution           -- execution parameter sets
iris_pipeline_execution_parameter -- per-execution parameter values
```

### Runtime tables

```sql
iris_pipeline_run                 -- logical run (has many attempts)
iris_pipeline_run_snapshot        -- config snapshot JSON at execute time
iris_pipeline_run_job             -- job-level status for latest projection
iris_pipeline_run_execution       -- one row per attempt (INITIAL / RESUME / RERUN)
iris_pipeline_run_execution_job   -- job-level status per attempt
iris_watermark_record             -- watermark state per job
```

Spring Batch metadata tables (`BATCH_*`) are infrastructure detail.
Product semantics live entirely in the `iris_pipeline_run*` tables.

Migrations are managed by **Flyway** (`backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/`).

---

## Runtime Execution Model

```
execute(pipelineId)
  │
  ├── PipelineConfigService.reconstruct()   → SyncJobDefinition[]
  ├── PipelineRunCommandService.create()    → PipelineRun + PipelineRunJob rows
  ├── PipelineRunSnapshotService.persist()  → snapshot JSON
  └── PipelineRunLaunchService.launch()
        │
        ├── group jobs by stageSequenceOrder
        └── for each stage:
              ├── launch all jobs in parallel  (Spring Batch JobLauncher)
              ├── wait for all jobs to settle  (stage barrier)
              └── if any job FAILED → project future stages as NOT_RUN, stop
```

### Listener Chain

State transitions are listener-driven, not polled:

```
Spring Batch JobListener / StepListener
  └── CustomJobListener
        └── PipelineRunLifecycleService    (update iris_pipeline_run_execution_job)
              └── PipelineMetricsPublisher  (Micrometer counters + gauges)
```

This keeps the execution engine decoupled from observability concerns.

## API Surface

All endpoints are under `/api/v1/`. Workspace is resolved from `X-Iris-Workspace-Key` (default: `default`).

### Config

| Method | Path | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/sync-config` | List all pipelines |
| `GET` | `/sync-config/{id}` | Get pipeline config |
| `POST` | `/sync-config` | Create pipeline |
| `PUT` | `/sync-config/{id}` | Replace pipeline config |
| `PATCH` | `/sync-config/{id}` | Partial update |
| `DELETE` | `/sync-config/{id}` | Delete pipeline |
| `POST` | `/sync-config/import` | Import from YAML/JSON |

### Folders

| Method | Path | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/pipeline-tree` | Full folder tree with pipelines |
| `POST` | `/pipeline-folders` | Create folder |
| `PUT` | `/pipeline-folders/{id}` | Rename / move folder |
| `GET` | `/pipeline-folders/{id}/delete-preview` | Preview delete impact |
| `DELETE` | `/pipeline-folders/{id}` | Delete folder |

### Runtime

| Method | Path | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/sync-pipeline` | Execute pipeline |
| `POST` | `/sync-pipeline/{runId}/resume` | Resume failed run |
| `POST` | `/sync-pipeline/{runId}/rerun` | Rerun from snapshot |
| `POST` | `/sync-pipeline/{runId}/stop` | Stop in-flight run |
| `GET` | `/sync-pipeline/{runId}` | Run detail |
| `GET` | `/sync-pipeline?pipelineId=&limit=&beforeRunId=` | Run history |
| `GET` | `/sync-pipeline/recent` | Recent runs (workspace) |
| `DELETE` | `/sync-pipeline/{runId}` | Delete run record |

### Observability

| Path | Description |
|---|---|
| `/actuator/health` | Spring Boot health |
| `/actuator/metrics` | Micrometer metric names |
| `/actuator/prometheus` | Prometheus scrape endpoint |
| `/api/v1/overview/summary` | Dashboard summary |

---

## Real-time Events (SSE)

Two SSE channels:

```
GET /api/v1/events/runs           → workspace-scoped (all runs)
GET /api/v1/events/runs/{runId}   → run-scoped
```

Event types: `run_started`, `job_started`, `job_finished`, `run_completed`, `run_failed`, `run_stopped`.

The frontend subscribes to the run-scoped channel on `RunDetailPage` and re-fetches run detail on each event.
No client-side state machine — every event is a cache invalidation.

---

## Frontend Structure

```
frontend/src/
├── pages/        Route-level components (6 pages)
├── layout/       Shell layouts (ConsoleLayout, PipelineWorkspaceLayout)
├── components/   Reusable UI (StageLaneBoard, SqlEditor, etc.)
├── lib/          api.ts (all axios calls), usePipelineEvents.ts (SSE hook)
├── types/        Domain types (irispipe.ts)
└── state/        ThemeProvider, LayoutProvider
```

Routing mirrors the resource hierarchy:

```
/overview                              → dashboard + recent runs
/pipeline                              → folder explorer
/pipeline/items/:id/config             → pipeline config (kanban board)
/pipeline/items/:id/runs               → run history
/pipeline/items/:id/runs/:runId        → run detail
/settings                              → connection library
```
